name: ...Time's Up
Text: Can only be played when Tick Tock... is in your Ring. ACE: During your opponent's turn, you may RFG your top 3 Arsenal cards to reverse any maneuver.

name: ...You Never Did!
Logos: Damian Priest, Rated R Superstar, Rhea Ripley, Finn Balor
Text: Can only be played when your opponent's non-Permanent card becomes successful. They put that card into their hand (or Backlash, if applicable) instead, the card does not count as played, and end their turn; when You Think You Know Me? is in your Ring, they discard their card instead.

name: 1D
Text: When successful, your opponent overturns 10 cards (if played as a maneuver, 20 cards instead.) This cannot be reversed, reduced, or prevented.

name: 20 Years of Destruction
Text: Packed: you can pack The New Legends of the WWE and non-Virtual maneuvers with Kane and either Undertaker or Deadman Inc. logos. When playing a Superstar-specific maneuver, you may blank the text this turn. When the first card played on your turn is a Superstar-specific TMF, you may immediately play another Superstar-specific TMF with it.

name: 7 Years, 8 Months, 1 Day
Text: When Madison Square Garden, New York City is in your Ring, this card is F: 0, and when you have WWWF Heavyweight Championship in your Ring your opponent cannot respond to this card. Recover 7- Ringside cards and 8- RFG cards, and then draw 1- cards.

name: A Force You Can't Hope To CTRL
Text: Recover 2 of your other Ring cards. ACE: When this card is Flipped face-up, you may Flip 2 of your other Ring cards, and then RFG this card.

name: A Trail Of Woe
Text: When packing this card you can pack Standing Moonsault and Dance Break!. Ignore 'non-Unique' in the text of your other Victoria-specific cards, they can be packed as if they are not Cheater or Fan Favorite, when they are non-Unique they are F: 0, and their ACE cannot be reversed. When they are in Ringside, replace '1' with '2' in their text. Your Mind Games counts as Battling The Voices for your effects. When Diva Bikini Contest is in your Ring, replace 'Ringside' with 'Ring or Ringside' in the text of Widow's Peak.

name: A-Town Down
Text: As an action, -25F, Recover this card and then Ring Search 1 face-down card.

name: African Tribal Mask
Text: When your opponent's non-Superstar-specific effect would let them look at your hand or Backlash, they instead do not. During their turn, when they play a card, you may hide this card, Bury any number of Hand cards, and draw that many.

name: All Day
Text: When this card is Flipped face-up, Recover 1- Ringside cards and Flip this card face-down.

name: Almost Only Counts in Horseshoes and Hand Grenades
Text: Cannot be packed when packing San Diego, California, and can only be played when Pinpoint Precision Offense is revealed. Cannot be blanked. Your 'Precision' Backlash cards do not take up Ring slots and can be played from Ringside. Your 'Precision' maneuvers are +2D, and when they are successful, put 1- Ringside Backlash cards into your Backlash. Your opponent cannot play Hybrid cards to your 'Precision' actions.

name: Austin Theory
Text: Once during each of your turns you may Flip 1 of your Ring cards. When you Flip your card face-up, you may draw 1- cards, and when it is not a non-Hybrid Reversal, you may Recover it. When the Recovered card had 'Rolling' in the title, draw 1- cards. Your 'Rolling' maneuvers are +1 Stun. You can pack Standing Moonsault. You cannot pack Baghdad, Iraq.

name: Backed by The Honorary Uce
Text: During your turn, when you play a non-Volley non-RMS maneuver without 'victory' in the text, you may hide this card and if your maneuver is unsuccessful, you may resolve its text as if it was successful. If the maneuver is successful, it is blank until the end of the turn. When this card is hidden, and your opponent successfully plays a maneuver, you may reveal this card and then their maneuver is -3D.

name: Bailed Out By Mami
Text: Completely reverse any non-maneuver card, any ACE, or, when overturned, any non-damage card effect. When this card is in your Ring, it is considered in your Ringside for your Ability.

name: Banger After Banger...
Text: Can only be played after a successful card. After damage is applied, end your opponent's turn. When this card is in your Ring, all maneuvers are +1D for every Ring maneuver. When your opponent plays a maneuver with a reversal restriction from his effect, it is -1D for each of their Ring maneuvers.

name: BASH at the Beach
Text: Your BASH Pre-match do not take up Ring slots. ACE: When your opponent plays a non-Superstar-specific Unique maneuver, you may discard 2 and then their card counts as non-Unique for your reversal cards.

name: Best Boot In The Business
Text: As a maneuver, when you are Charlotte, this card is a TMF instead. When you are Rhea Ripley, this card is Multi. As an action, discard this card, put 1 Ringside Mid-match card into your Backlash, and end your turn.

name: Big High Five
Text: Cannot be reversed when played as a Counter (Hand). Promo: 5, and then Bury this card and 3- Ringside cards.

name: Bitter Rivals
Text: *Reveal this card when you play a Pre-match Feud. Cannot be packed by Doink, or when you are not packing a Pre-match Feud. You cannot play non-Superstar-specific Pre-match Objects, and your non-'Politics' Feud cannot be blanked by non-'Shenanigans' effects.

name: Breakker's Overhead Suplex
Text: Can be searched for as if non-Unique. When played as a Counter, cannot be reversed from Backlash. Bury 4- Ringside cards.

name: Breakker's Press Powerslam
Text: When played as a Counter, can only be reversed from Arsenal. When this card is in your Ring, no player can move RFG cards to any other location. During your opponent's turn, when this card is in your Ring, they may overturn 5 cards, and then you Bury this card.

name: Broken Arrow
Text: When played as a maneuver, you may put 3 cards from under The Archer of Infamy into your Ringside. If you do, can only be reversed from Arsenal. As a reversal, ignore any reversal restriction from a card, reverse any 'Plex' card.

name: Bron Breakker
Text: Your Grapples are +3D and +1 Stun. During your turn, when your NXT card is successful, you may Promo: 2. You can pack No Sell Maneuver, Beware of Dog, The Frankensteiner, The Steinerline, and non-Throwback Steiner Recliner (they are NXT instead), and your 'Military' and 'Press' Grapples are Unique, Multi, NXT instead, and also TMF, but they are not Heat, Cheater, or Raw.

name: Canada's Greatest Export
Text: Can only be packed by Trish Stratus. Your Superstar-specific Backlash cards do not take up Ring slots. At the end of the Pre-match, you may play 100% Stratusfaction Guaranteed and 1 Enter The Stratus-phere regardless of Fortitude (cards with those titles are Superstar-specific, and Permanent when you have no other cards with those titles in your Ring). When your opponent reverses the ACE of Enter the Stratus-phere, your turn does not end but you cannot Activate cards with that title for the rest of the turn. When you have lower Fortitude and your action is unsuccessful, look at their hand. You may choose 1 card: they RFG it or they randomly discard a Backlash card. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, they do both.

name: Cap-Kota
Text: Replace a Superstar on WWE Women's Tag Team Title Belts with 'Dakota Kai'. When you have equal or lower Fortitude, your opponent cannot play Hybrid or Backlash reversals with 'reverse' in the text to your first 'Kick' maneuver each turn. When played as a Counter, ignore 'can only be played...' in the text of your 'Kick' maneuvers.

name: Catch-as-Catch-Can
Text: Packed: you cannot pack SAVE_US.X29. When Calgary, Alberta, Canada is in your Ring, and you would search your Arsenal for the Chain trait, you may instead Bury 2- Ringside non-Reversal cards; when you would move Ringside cards to Arsenal for Calgary, Alberta, Canada, you may instead Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique non-Superstar-specific printed F: 5- Chain card. When Calgary, Alberta, Canada is not in your Ring and your Chain maneuver is successful, Bury 1- Ringside cards; before each of your Draw Segments, you may put Flawless Transition from any non-Ring area into your Backlash (your effects cannot move that card from your Ring).

name: Chase University
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played during the Venue phase. Congratulations, you are now enrolled at Chase University. Your School Boy can only be reversed from Arsenal, and replace '3' with '5' in its text. Your Team Spirit cannot be reversed. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may overturn 2 cards, and then your opponent plays with their hand revealed until the end of the turn.

name: Conflict Resolution
Text: Promo: # and Bury any cards not chosen (# = the reversed maneuver's damage). Then choose 1 card in your opponent's Ringside and they Stack it.

name: Crown Jewel
Text: Can only be played when Blaze of Glory is revealed. Packed: replace 'Mid-match Superstar-specific and Reversal' with 'Superstar-specific and Mid-match' on your All Together Now, and you can pack He's on Fire!, Heated Exchange, and Nuclear Heat in addition to your other Pre-match cards; you cannot pack 'Diego' cards. When you have equal or lower fortitude, your opponent cannot Activate non-Superstar-specific reversal effects, or play non-Superstar-specific reversals of D: #+ to your non-Unique printed Heat maneuvers played from Ringside (# = number of your printed Ring Heat maneuvers +1.)

name: CTRL The Stage, CTRL The Cage
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent's Stipulation is blank. No player may win the game via non-Superstar-specific card effect. You also count as Bayley for your Title Belts. When your maneuver without a reversal restriction from your card is unsuccessful, Flip 1- of your face-down Ring cards face-up.

name: Dakota Kai
Text: Once during each of your turns, you may Flip 1 card in your Ring face-down, reveal your top 5 Arsenal cards, put 1 revealed non-reversal card into your hand and Stack the remaining cards or shuffle. You can pack Multi 'Kick' maneuvers. You cannot pack Baghdad, Iraq.

name: Damage CTRL
Text: After damage is applied from your opponent's maneuver or D: 3+ reversal, RFG any number of Ringside cards overturned for damage, and then Recover half that many Ringside cards or half that many random RFG cards (rounded up). You can pack I'm a Role Model!, and Bayley, Dakota Kai and IYO SKY-specific maneuvers as if they are not Multi. You cannot pack Baghdad, Iraq. You are a Tag Team.

name: Damian Priest
Text: Your 'Precision' and 'Shoot' maneuvers are not Cheater, and are considered to have 'Precision' and 'Shoot' in the title for your non-reversal effects. When you play a printed 'Precision' maneuver, you may increase the number of cards you move with that card's effect by +1. Your F: 0 'Precision' maneuvers are Multi, and when you have lower Fortitude, ignore 'completely' on your opponent's reversals to that card. Your Pinpoint Precision Offense is always revealed.

name: Ding Dong! Hello?
Text: When you are Bayley, this card is NXT. Can only be played after a successful D: 1+ card. Blank that card, it is reduced to 1D, and cannot be reversed from your Arsenal. End your opponent's turn. When played by The Role Model, after damage has been applied, Arsenal Search 1 non-Unique action.

name: Do You Want The Bark or The Bite
Text: Can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards. Your opponent may discard # cards and overturn # card. If they do not, Bury #- Ringside cards, and draw #- cards. # = the number of your Ring grapples.

name: Dogfaced Gremlin Mentality
Text: Draw 2- cards. Do not discard for your No Sell Maneuver cards.

name: Dom Dom's Low Blow
Text: When your opponent is a Male Superstar, this card is Multi and can only be reversed from Arsenal. As a reversal, -5F.

name: Dom's 619
Text: Can only be played as a Counter or after a successful maneuver. When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, this card is -6F and can only be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Dom's Frog Splash
Text: Can only be played after a successful maneuver or as a Counter. When this card is a High Risk, cannot be reversed.

name: Dominik Mysterio
Text: When your opponent plays a maneuver, you may reveal 1 applicable reversal from your hand (ignoring reversal and play restrictions). If you do, Recover it and either 1 Ringside card or 3- random Ringside cards, and their maneuver becomes successful. You can pack High-Flying Style and The Three Amigos, but you cannot pack No Matching Tights.

name: Doomsday Saito
Text: When you have F: 30+, this card is Multi, +5D, and a TMF instead; and when you have 30+ RFG cards, can only be reversed by 2 reversal cards from Arsenal. As a Grapple, when this card is unsuccessful, you may put it into your hand.

name: Eat Defeat
Text: Can only be packed by Gail Kim, or when packing The Era of the Superstar. Can be packed as if it is not Multi. When you are Gail Kim, this card is +7F, +7D, Gail Kim-specific, SmackDown, and a TMF instead. Your opponent discards cards equal to your Ring cards with 'The Era of the Superstar' in the text.

name: ECW Tag Team Title Belts
Text: Can be packed by Tag Teams. Cannot be packed when packing other 'ECW' Title Belts. Your maneuvers are +1D, and when The House That Hardcore Built is revealed, your Hand Size is +1. Superstar Value +0

name: Everyone Is Jealous of Me!
Text: When your opponent's effect reduces your Hand Size, their Hand Size is also reduced by that many. No player can play cards with the same title as a face-down card in your Ring. When they play a card with the same title as a card in your Ring, you may Bury 1 Ringside card. You can play Rolling Takedown as if your opponent's played card is a Grapple maneuver.

name: Fall and Pray
Text: When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it into your Ring. Your opponent RFG 1 additional card for Managed by Scarlett. During their turn, when this card is in your Ring, they may RFG 2 Hand cards to RFG this card.

name: False Finish
Text: When this card reverses from Hand, Recover 5- Ringside cards. When this card reverses from Arsenal, put it into your Ring. ACE: During your turn, when this card is in your Ring, you may RFG this card and then all players Ring / RFG Search 1- non-reversal TMF.

name: Feeling Ucey
Logos: Solo Sikoa, The Tribal Chief, The Usos, The Great Liberator, The Bloodline
Text: Choose 2: Draw 4, Recover 4 RFG cards, Recover 4 Ringside cards, or opponent discards 4. When you are The Usos, you choose only 1 of these effects, but they are all +1.

name: For the Greater Good
Text: Cannot be packed with Elimination Chamber. Can be played during any Pre-match phase. Your Mid-match cards with the same brand as your Allegiance do not take up Ring slots. Until the first turn of the game, your opponent cannot blank your non-Stipulation Pre-match cards with non-'Shenanigans' effects, move cards from your Hand or Backlash, or reduce your Hand Size, and their non-Superstar-specific card effects do not increase their Hand Size or let them draw more than 2 cards. Your turns cannot be skipped, and their non-Reversal cards do not end your turn. You start the game.

name: Ford's Blockbuster
Text: As a maneuver, can only be played after a successful maneuver or as a Counter. When played after a maneuver, this card is Multi and ignore 'completely' in the text of your opponent's reversals to it. As an action, Bury this card and then Flip 1 non-Superstar-specific non-F: 0 card in any Ring.

name: From Deepest Darkest Africa
Text: Cannot be blanked. Cannot be packed with printed D: 1+ Pre-match cards. When One Man Gang is not revealed, your opponent's Hand Size is -3 and your Hand Size is -2. Your Fortitude is +1 for each Stun in your Ring. ACE: During your turn you may RFG this card and then your next maneuver played this turn is +3 Stun.

name: G.O.D. Mode
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase. Cannot be blanked. When your opponent plays a Universally Unique card, you may reveal 1 Backlash card with the same title, put it into your Ring, and they put their card into their Backlash (ignoring the Permanent trait). You may choose to have them resolve first at the end of the Pre-match phase, and you choose the order they resolve their effects in during the Pre-match phase. When you are The Bloodline and your non-Chain maneuver is unsuccessful, your opponent may discard 1 card (2 cards if the maneuver is Superstar-specific); if they do not, they draw 2 and skip their next turn (regardless of Old School Wrestling Match).

name: G.T.K.
Text: When successful as maneuver, if this card is not reversed from Arsenal, you win the game via Pinfall Victory. When successful as a reversal by Damage CTRL, discard this card.

name: Gang's Clubbing Blows
Text: When One Man Gang is revealed, can be played from RFG. When this card is in your Ring and you would draw for Stun, you may have your opponent overturn that many cards instead.

name: Get Real
Text: As an Action, Recover this card, and your next maneuver this turn cannot be reversed from Backlash. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-damage card effect (even during the Pre-match phase), or any non-Unique card, put this card into your hand.

name: Good Old Fashioned Donnybrook Match
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase. Cannot be blocked. You can play maneuvers in your Backstage, regardless of Volley Lock; your opponent may ignore their reversal restrictions from Hand and Arsenal. ACE: When they play a maneuver, you may Bury your hand and draw that many -1, and then put 1 of your non-RMS non-reversal Ring maneuvers into your Backstage.

name: I Came For Kombat
Text: Completely reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver card. When this card is in your Ring, and any player plays an action, they overturn 2 cards. When this card is in your Ring or Ringside, before your Draw Segment you may Recover it.

name: I Got A Lot Left In The Tank!
Text: *Reveal this card when you are about to lose the game. Recover 10- Ringside cards, 2- RFG cards, end the current turn, and the game continues. Your first 10D+ maneuver each turn is Multi.

name: I Served My Time!
Text: Choose 1 card in your opponent's Ring, and Recover Ringside and/or RFG cards up to the damage of the chosen card. When this card is in your Ring, the chosen card is blank.

name: I'm Coming For You
Text: Cannot be blanked. When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, your printed 4D+ maneuvers are High Risks instead. ACE: When your opponent plays a maneuver, you may RFG this card to reduce that maneuver's damage to 0. ACE: Once per turn, when you are The Judgment Day and your opponent's Superstar-specific card becomes successful, you may put 1 of your non-Active non-RMS D: 1+ Ring cards into your Ringside, and then their card is considered Face and Heel for your Ability. This effect cannot be reversed.

name: Inclusivity, Acceptance, Resilience
Text: Can only be played after damage is applied from your opponent's maneuver. They put their top # Arsenal cards into their Ringside (# = the maneuver's printed damage, max. 8). End their turn. ACE: During your turn, you may Recover 8- Ringside cards, and then RFG this card.

name: Innovative, Aggressive, Unpredictable
Text: This card is -1F for each maneuver in your Ring. Recover 8- Ringside cards and Ringside Search 2- maneuvers. ACE: Once during each of your turns you may discard 1 card, and then name a non-Unique maneuver. This card also counts as that card until the end of the turn.

name: It's All About CTRL
Text: When played, can only be reversed by 1 reversal card. ACE: When this card is Flipped face-up you may Bury this card, and then Bury 2- Ringside cards and 3- Hand cards, and draw cards up to the number of Hand cards you Buried.

name: It's Fight Night!
Text: When you have no printed D: 1+ Pre-match Ring cards, your Fortitude is +1 for each of your Ring 'Brawl' and 'Beating' cards. Your Ready to Fight does not take up a Ring slot, and its ACE cannot be reversed. When your opponent's maneuver is successful, you may Backlash / Ringside Search Ready to Fight and put it into your Ring (when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, you may put it into your Backlash instead).

name: It's Me, Austin!
Text: When played from Hand by Austin Theory, reverse any non-Superstar-specific maneuver. When played from Hand by The Genetic Jackhammer, reverse any blank card. When your opponent has a Stone Cold Steve Austin-specific Ring card, instead reverse any card.

name: It's Time to Rock and Roll!
Text: Can only be packed by Trish Stratus. When this card is discarded for a Superstar-specific ACE, draw 1- card, your opponent cannot play reversals to the ACE, and their overturn effect can only be reversed by Booby Trap. Once during each of your turns, when you successfully Activate a Superstar-specific card, you may Ringside/RFG Search this card.

name: IYO SKY
Text: Non-Superstar-specific effects cannot Flip your cards face-down. Once during each of your turns, when you would play a Set-up card from Hand, you may first Flip one of your Ring cards face-down and then ignore the 'can only be played...' text. When played, your Double Underhook Back Breaker cards are Multi and also High Risk. You can pack High-Flying Style. You cannot pack Lumberjack Match or Falls Count Anywhere Match.

name: IYO's Asai Moonsault
Text: Can only be played after a 3D+ maneuver, or a Set-up card. When played after Springboard, -5F and cannot be reversed from Backlash. As a reversal, reverse any card played after a Set-up.

name: IYO's Crossface
Text: As a maneuver, -1F for each of your face-down Ring cards, and when you have 5+ face-down Ring cards, this card is a TMF instead. Flip 2- of your Ring cards.

name: IYO's Faceplant
Text: As a maneuver, -15F, and after damage is applied, RFG 3- of your opponent's Ringside cards. As a reversal, ignore any reversal restrictions from the reversed card, reverse any non-Chain non-Superstar-specific maneuver with a printed reversal restriction.

name: IYO's Springboard Dropkick
Text: As a maneuver, -9F, and can only be played after a successful card or as a Counter, and when successful, Bury any number of Hand cards and draw that many cards.

name: Kabuki Mist
Text: Opponent discards 2 random cards.

name: Kai's Double Boot Stomp
Text: Can only be played after a successful card. When this card would be Flipped face-down, first you may Stack 1- RFG maneuvers.

name: Kai-Ropractor
Text: When played after a 'Kick' maneuver, cannot be reversed from Arsenal.

name: Karrion Kross
Text: Once per turn, when you play a Unique reversal, you may Bury 1 non-'Divine' RFG card. You can pack No Sell Maneuver and up to 2 copies of Unique Arsenal reversals. You cannot play Unique non-reversals with a title already in your Ring, or pack Egomaniacal.

name: King Kota
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Pre-match Capacity is +1. Arsenal Search 1 non-unique 'Kick' maneuver and discard it. When you Flip a card, Bury 1- random Ringside cards. When your opponent's maneuver is reversed, Stack 1- non-reversal Ringside maneuvers.

name: Knees Up!
Text: This card is considered Superstar-specific for your opponent's effects. When this card reverses from Arsenal, it is considered 2 reversal cards, and put it into your Ring instead.

name: Kross Hammer
Text: As a maneuver, -20F, look at your opponent's top 3 Arsenal cards, RFG 1 of them and Bury the rest. As a reversal, reverse any Chain, Heat, Volley, or BASH card.

name: Kross-Jacket
Text: This card is also considered a Submission for your effects. When played after a 'Suplex' maneuver, cannot be reversed from Arsenal. Bury 1 RFG card.

name: Life Behind Bars
Text: When this card is in your Ring, no player can move Ringside cards except by their Ability.

name: Live Forever
Text: Cannot be reversed by Hybrid cards. Recover this and 3- Ringside cards.

name: Longest Reigning SmackDown Women's Champion In History!
Text: Cannot be blanked and does not take up a slot in your Ring. After all Pre-match phases, you may put Smackdown Women's Championship Belt from your Backlash into your Ring. Your Fortitude is +1 for each of your printed non-Pre-match Ring Cheater cards. Your Mid-match actions do not take up Ring slots. Your actions are also considered maneuvers for their Stipulations.

name: LongEST Suplex
Text: When this card is RFG for Watch Me Shine, put this card into your Hand. When this card is not Multi, your opponent cannot play Backlash reversals to it. When this card is Multi, it is +4D.

name: Lose CTRL
Text: When this card is Flipped face-up, draw 1- cards.

name: Lose Yer Head
Text: Can only be played after a successful maneuver. Blank that maneuver's text and end your opponent's turn. Your opponent may skip their Draw Segment and discard 3 cards to put this card into your Ringside. ACE: When you play a maneuver, you may RFG any number of Ringside cards and your opponent's non-F: 0 reversals are +2F for each card removed.

name: Lost In The Sky
Text: Cannot be moved to Arsenal by Tokyo Shock or A Force You Can't Hope To CTRL. ACE: When this card is in your Ring, during your turn, you may RFG 2 of your face-down cards and then Recover this card.

name: Lucha Style Action
Text: *Reveal this card when High-Flying Style is put into your Ring. Cannot be packed by Doink, or when packing Cruiserweight Style Action or Lumberjack Match. This card is considered Superstar-specific. Your Springboard counts as From the Top Rope and From the Middle Turnbuckle for your effects, replace 'played card' with 'played card, or as a Counter' in its text, your opponent cannot play Backlash reversals to it, and if your next card played would be a High Risk, ignore 'Can only be played after...' in its text. When they play a card that would move Ringside cards, you may hide this card and then their card is considered Roll Out of The Ring for your printed High Risk Reversal card.

name: Macro Aggression Side Slam
Text: Your opponent cannot play Hybrid reversals to this card. When you have 5+ lower Fortitude, this card is an action instead and -7F.

name: Managed by Clarence Mason
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your Superstar-specific cards are -#F and cannot be prevented from being played. (# = the total damage on Reversal cards in your opponent's Ring) When you play a maneuver after Irish Whip or Throw Into the Corner Turnbuckle, you may reveal 1 Hand or Backlash reversal (except Restricted Use in This Area). If you do, your opponent cannot play the revealed card to your maneuver; if you do not, and your maneuver is unsuccessful, they reveal their hand.

name: Managed by Kim Chee
Text: Your opponent's maneuvers are -1 Stun. During your turn, when this card is in your Ringside, you may RFG it and then Recover 5 Ringside cards. ACE: When they play a maneuver, you may put this card into your Ringside and then Arsenal Search 1 Over Sell Maneuver.

name: Managed by Scarlett
Text: Cannot be blanked. Your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. Can be played from Ringside. Before every Draw Segment, all players RFG their top Arsenal card. Their cards overturned for your non-damage effects is reduced to 0. ACE: During your turn, you may RFG this card and then Recover 10- RFG cards. When you have 10- Arsenal cards or 20+ lower Fortitude, this effect cannot be reversed.

name: Million Dollar Smile
Text: When successful, you may discard 2 cards. If you do, your first card played on your next turn cannot be reversed.

name: Mr. McMahon's Vested Interest
Text: Can be played during any Pre-match phase. When packing this card, your non-Throwback In The Interest of Fairness... are not Heel, do not take up Ring slots, and your opponent draws 1 fewer card for its effect. When played, Backlash Search 1- 'McMahon' Pre-match cards and put it into your Ring. Your 'McMahon' cards cannot be blanked. Arsenal Search Throwback Don't Cross the Boss and put it into your Ring (it is Permanent).

name: Muta's Arm Triangle
Text: As a maneuver, this card is -5F and when played as a Counter, cannot be reversed by D: 2+ cards. As a reversal, reverse any Submission, or completely reverse any 'Punch' card.

name: Muta's Martial Arts Kick
Text: As a maneuver, -3F. As a reversal, -5D, reverse any non-maneuver card; when that card was Unique, draw 2 cards. This card is also counts as Roundhouse Kick for your effects.

name: Now You're Going to School!
Text: Requirement: Enrolled at Chase University. Arsenal Search 6- non-Unique cards and then randomly Bury 3 Hand cards.

name: Nuclear Heat
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Heat. Cannot be blanked. Your printed Heat maneuvers are +2D. Replace 'discard' with 'reveal' in the text of your Leave Me Alone, do not RFG Heat cards for Headstrong, you are considered to have lower Fortitude for I Already Warned You, and when you have 10+ lower Fortitude, Revolving Takedown can also reverse a non-Unique maneuver.

name: NXT Womens Tag Team Title Belts
Text: Can only be packed by a Female Superstar. Your Mid-match Capacity is +1. Before the first Draw Segment, you may Bury 2- Hand cards and draw that many. When you are Dakota Kai, Ember Moon, or IYO SKY, your opponent cannot prevent you from playing this card. Superstar Value +0

name: Over The Moonsault
Text: This card is -1F for each of your face-down Ring cards, and considered a High Risk for your card effects. Can only be played after a 5D+ maneuver. When unsuccessfully played by IYO SKY, your opponent RFG 2 Hand cards and their top 2 Arsenal cards.

name: Owen Hart Joins the Nation
Text: When packing this card, you can pack Enough is Enough, It's Time for a Change, I Am Not a Nugget!, and non-Hybrid Owen Hart-specific maneuvers. Ignore 'The card...card.' text on your Cross Body Block. Your opponent counts as The Rattlesnake for your Owen's Tombstone Piledriver.  During any turn, when you use your Ability and have greater Fortitude, you may hide another Superstar-specific Backstage card to ignore 'non-reversal' in your Ability. When you have 2+ hidden Nation of Domination-specific Backstage cards, your Superstar-specific maneuvers are Chain.

name: Pinpoint Precision Offense
Text: Cannot be packed by Doink, or when packing Back to Basics or Great Technical Prowess. Arsenal Search 10 non-Unique printed 'Precision' maneuvers, and put them under this card; if you do not, hide this card. name: Throw You Around Like A Rag Doll!
Text: When you have 10+ lower Fortitude, this card is F: 0 and your opponent cannot respond to it. Your opponent cannot play reversals to your non-Unique Grapples for the rest of the turn.

name: Tick Tock…
Text: Your opponent may discard 3 cards. If they do not, Bury 5- RFG cards.

name: Tilt-a-Whirl Arm Drag
Text: When successful as a maneuver, Recover this card and your opponent overturns 4 cards. When played from your hand, reverse any Strike or Grapple. When overturned, reverse any Submission or High Risk.

name: Tokyo Shock
Text: Cannot be blanked. Can be played during the Venue phase. Your High Risk maneuvers are +1 Stun, and when unsuccessful, you may Recover them. Replace 'Strike' with 'High Risk' in the text of your Trash Can. ACE: Once during each of your turns, you may Bury 1 Hand card, and then Recover 1 Ringside card, randomly RFG 1 of your opponent's Ringside cards, and RFG 1 of your face-down Ring cards.

name: Veer Mahaan is Coming
Text: As an action, Recover this card and 1 non-Unique RFG card. As a reversal, when overturned, reverse any non-damage card effect and Recover this card.

name: Victory Foot Stomp
Text: When successful, if you have 10+ face-down Ring cards you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: War Games
Text: Requirement: Allegiance: Faction, or you are a Stable. No player can play non-Superstar-specific Run-in cards without their Faction's title in the text, or move RFG cards with non-Superstar-specific effects (except cards with 'Million' in the text). When you are a NXT or WCW Superstar, your opponent cannot discard more than 2 cards when activating Sustained damage.

name: We Got The Power, We Got The Rage
Text: When packing this card, you can pack 3- Out of Control in your Backstage. When this card is revealed, put them into your Backlash, replace 'Can only be played' with 'Cannot be reversed' in their text, and they are not Active. When you play a 'CTRL' or 'Control' card you may Promo: 2. If successful, after damage is applied, you may flip that card face down and your opponent randomly Buries 1 Hand card.

name: We The Ones
Text: Can only be reversed by 1 reversal card. When this card is completely reversed, you may put it into your hand. Draw 1- cards, Stack 1- Ringside cards, Bury 1- RFG cards. When you are The Usos, double those numbers. They discard 1 card, Bury 1 Hand card, Stack 1 Hand card, RFG 1 Ringside card, and overturn 1 card.

name: We Want the Gold, Sucka!
Text: When packing this card, your Interviewed by Mean Gene Okerlund and cards listed in its text are WCW. Your Title Belt and Superstar-specific cards do not take up Ring slots, and when you would discard for their effects, you may Bury that many Hand cards instead. For every Title Belt in a Ring (max. 4), your maneuvers are +2D and +1 Stun. They cannot gain Stun from other effects. When your opponent's turn ends without playing a maneuver, Ringside Search 1 Strike. When that is the first card played on your turn, it is a Multi High Risk instead, and their successful reversals are blank and deal no damage.

name: Who's Your Papi?
Text: When you have lower Fortitude and your opponent's maneuver becomes successful, they may discard 1 card. If they do not, after damage is applied, end the turn. Your second High Risk played each turn cannot be reversed. Once during each of your turns, you may RFG 1 of your Ring maneuvers and then they Bury 1 Hand card.

name: With Military Precision
Text: Bury any number of RFG 'Precision' cards and Arsenal Search 1 'Precision' maneuver without 'reversed' in the text. When this card is in your Ring and you have 10+ printed 'Precision' Ring maneuvers, you win the game via Pinfall Victory.

name: Wrestling's Greatest Champion
Text: Can only be played after a successful maneuver; blank that card's text and damage this turn, and end the turn. ACE: When playing a maneuver, you may Bury any number of cards from under Back to Basics or WWWF Heavyweight Championship Title Belt and then your maneuver is +2D for each Buried card.

name: Wrist Lock
Text: As a reversal, +20F, reverse any non-Unique non-Throwback maneuver, or any Non-Superstar-specific 'Arm' card. When successful, look at your opponent's hand.

name: WWWF Heavyweight Championship Title Belt
Text: Packed: you cannot pack other Title Belts, but you can pack Punch regardless of logo. Cannot be blanked or prevented from being played. Can be played from Ringside. Each turn, your first maneuver played from under Back to Basics is +3D, and can only be reversed from Arsenal, or by printed F:0 or Unique Hand or Backlash reversals, when it is unsuccessful and you have 10+ lower Fortitude, your opponent overturns # (# =  their Ring reversals minus your Ring maneuvers). When Back to Basics is not in your Ring, Arsenal Search any number of non-TMF Superstar-specific maneuvers and put them under this card; you may play them from under this card as if from Hand, and when you would Bury non-TMF cards for The Italian Strongman, you can put them under this card instead. Superstar Value +2

name: You Couldn't Hit the Broad Side of a Barn!
Text: Requirement: Pinpoint Precision Offense is revealed. When played from hand, reverse any non-Unique card. Bury 1- RFG cards.

name: You Gotta be JOKING Me!
Text: Can only be played after a successful non-Superstar-specific action (when you have lower Fortitude, any action). Blank that card's text and damage and end your opponent's turn. During your next turn, you may play that card as if from Hand (or Backlash, if applicable). If you do, after that card is resolved, put it into your opponent's Ringside instead of any other location.

name: You Look Fly Today
Text: Cannot be packed with There is No Escape. Backlash Search I Did It For You and Raisin' the Roof and put them into your Ring. They are Permanent and cannot be blanked. Your opponent cannot reverse your Rikishi-specific actions from hand, and when Drive Rikishi, Drive is successful, they overturn 6 cards. During your turn, you may hide this card and then Recover 3- Ring / Ringside / RFG Getting Cheeky With It (this cannot be prevented).

name: You Think You Know Me
Logos: The Judgment Day, The Rated R Superstar
Text: When you have lower Fortitude, this card is -5F. Unless you are The Rated R Superstar, discard 2 cards.

name: You Want A Friend? Get A Dog!
Text: Reverse any non-Superstar-specific non-maneuver or ACE. When this card is in your Ring, opponent must discard 1 card to Activate an ACE.
